items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Paul Pinochet in the context of the band ('Quinette that's when we picked up Paul Pinochet'), but the interviewee (Gene Ramey) does not speak about Paul Pinochet directly or confirm a personal relationship in the provided text.

ctx.x: Now, when we got out to Dallas again, then we --
Quinette that's when we picked up Paul Pinochet. And about that time Bird rejoined us. We got down to San Antonio, and I think Paul and what's his name got arrested.
